title: Chinese State Capitalism Institutional Architecture: The Corporate Objective Function & 6 Evidence Pillars

theoreticalModel.westernFreeMarketObjective: Maximize Profit(t) = Revenue(t) - Cost(t)  [Single-agent short-term quarterly ROI maximization]
theoreticalModel.explanation: Corporate strategy in state capitalism is not irrational price dumping, but a multi-variable optimization system where commercial profits are weighted alongside national strategic priorities (market dominance, technology assimilation, supply chain capture).

sixEvidencePillars.name: 1. National Industrial Blueprints
sixEvidencePillars.legalBasis: Made in China 2025, 14th Five-Year Plan for New Energy Vehicle Industry Development (2021–2035)
sixEvidencePillars.mechanism: Mandates target global market share thresholds and minimum 80% domestic supply chain localization for batteries, electric motors, power electronics, and connected vehicle platforms.

sixEvidencePillars.name: 2. State Policy Finance & Subsidized Capital
sixEvidencePillars.legalBasis: National Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund (Big Fund), China Development Bank (CDB) concessionary loans, SASAC capitalization
sixEvidencePillars.mechanism: Provides low-interest long-term financing and sovereign equity injections, insulating domestic champions from commercial margins and sustaining aggressive CapEx cycles during price wars.

sixEvidencePillars.name: 3. Upstream Mineral Supply Control
sixEvidencePillars.legalBasis: National Strategic Resource Security Directives & Strategic Mineral Reserve Protocols (Lithium, Cobalt, Graphite, Rare Earths)
sixEvidencePillars.mechanism: Subsidizes overseas mining acquisitions and grants domestic processing concessions, establishing monopoly control over global lithium refining (65%) and spherical graphite (90%).

sixEvidencePillars.name: 4. Strategic Technology & Mineral Export Controls
sixEvidencePillars.legalBasis: PRC Export Control Law (2020), Catalog of Technologies Prohibited or Restricted from Export (December 2023 Revision)
sixEvidencePillars.mechanism: Prohibits outbound transfer of rare-earth separation, gallium/germanium refining, and LFP cathode formulations, preventing foreign JVs from repatriating critical process IP.

sixEvidencePillars.name: 5. Extraterritorial Data & Intelligence Regimes
sixEvidencePillars.legalBasis: PRC National Intelligence Law Art. 7 (2017), Data Security Law (2021), Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL)
sixEvidencePillars.mechanism: Compels domestic organizations to assist state intelligence services upon request and statutorily bans outbound transfer of automotive telemetry, requiring bifurcated domestic IT architectures.

sixEvidencePillars.name: 6. Government-JV Subsidy Ecosystem & Party Governance
sixEvidencePillars.legalBasis: NEV Recommended Battery Whitelists, Municipal Land Concessions, PRC Company Law Art. 19 (Internal Party Committees)
sixEvidencePillars.mechanism: Historically excluded foreign battery makers to incubate domestic champions (CATL/BYD), while embedding Party Committee oversight directly into corporate governance structures.
